source_caption:
The Coldest Man in Westeros ⚔️

Prince Daemon Targaryen is one of the most complex and unpredictable figures in the history of House Targaryean. He is a famously polarizing figure in Westerosi history. Celebrated as the ultimate rogue prince, he was a peerless warrior wielding the Valyrian steel blade Dark Sister and a fearsome dragonrider bonded to Caraxes.

With House of the Dragon Season 3 officially premiering yesterday, the catastrophic war between the Blacks and the Greens has finally crossed the point of no return. 
The highly anticipated new season will consist of 8 action-packed episodes, dropping brand-new installments weekly every Sunday night (Monday mornings in India) until the massive season finale on August 9th.

source_details.synopsis: House of the Dragon is an American fantasy drama television series created by George R. R. Martin and Ryan Condal for HBO. A prequel to Game of Thrones (2011–2019), it is the second television series in the Game of Thrones franchise. Based on parts of Martin's 2018 book Fire & Blood, the series begins about 100 years after the Seven Kingdoms are united by the Targaryen conquest, nearly 200 years before the events of Game of Thrones, and 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen. Featuring an ensemble cast, the show portrays the events leading up to the decline of House Targaryen, a devastating war of succession known as the "Dance of the Dragons".
